## Company Name (TICKER) `[Category]`

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A

- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## Picard Medical, Inc. (PMI) `[Medical Devices]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.

## Bumble Inc. (BMBL) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.
- Bumble agreed to be acquired by Ithaca Holdings in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $1.3 billion, or $6.05 per Class A share, on October 13, 2026; the offer represented a 138% premium to Bumble’s October 9 unaffected close.[1] (HDFC Sky, Oct. 14; updated Oct. 15; publish time not stated)

## Fermi Inc. (FRMI) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Fermi signed a credit-support agreement with AMD for a lease covering the first phase of its Project Matador AI and energy facility in Carson County, Texas, supporting 222 MW of gross power capacity.[1] (HDFC Sky, Oct. 14; updated Oct. 15; publish time not stated)
- Fermi and AMD also signed a framework agreement exploring expansion of the project by up to 650 MW of gross power capacity.[1] (HDFC Sky, Oct. 14; updated Oct. 15; publish time not stated)
- Fermi reported more than $1.5 billion invested in Project Matador development to date.[1] (HDFC Sky, Oct. 14; updated Oct. 15; publish time not stated)

## Petróleo Brasileiro S.A. — Petrobras (PBR) `[Energy]`
- Petrobras ADRs fell 2.47% to $25.30 on October 15, while the USO oil fund rose 2.44%; Petrobras was among Latin American producers that declined during the session.[2] (Rio Times, Oct. 16; publish time not stated)
- Brazil’s market declined 1.06% and the Brazilian real weakened on October 15; Petrobras was reported down 1.29% in Brazil and 2.47% in New York.[3] (Rio Times, Oct. 16; publish time not stated)
- BofA analyst Leonardo Marcondes raised Petrobras’s price target from $22 to $28 and maintained a Buy rating on October 14.[4] (Markets Insider, Oct. 14 07:55 ET)
- Petrobras scheduled its third-quarter production and sales report for October 28, 2026, third-quarter financial results for November 10, 2026, and the results webcast for November 11, 2026.[4] (Ad Hoc News, Oct. 15 04:21 ET)
